other_conditions: Applicant must be admitted as a regular student in a government or recognized non‑government college
Applicant must not be admitted to any government hostel
College or the student's permanent residence should not be located within the geographical limits of the same local body (urban body/gram panchayat)
If examination results are delayed or the student fails, they become ineligible for the scheme in the following year
benefits_summary: Provides monthly rent assistance ranging from ₹1,000 to ₹2,000 per student depending on the location (city, district headquarters, tehsil/block).
